# Lot & Loaded — full text

Lot & Loaded originates off-market commercial parcels — industrial land, redevelopment and teardown sites — and puts them under contract at 65% of builder value. Builders are qualified on closing pace and see deals that fit their buy box. Partners register parcels with the house, locked for 30 days, and keep 50% of the collected fee. Free to join; the house makes money when deals close.


===== Lot & Loaded — Off-Market Commercial Land, Priced Right (https://santi856.github.io/lot-and-loaded/) =====

LOT & LOADED Builders Partners Sell your property Off-market commercial land & teardown sites Lot & Loaded: good dirt, priced right, brought to people who close. We find off-market commercial parcels — industrial land, redevelopment and teardown sites — and put them under contract at 65% of builder value . Builders in our community see deals that fit their box. Partners bring us the dirt and split the fee. Free to join. No membership fees — we make money when deals close, same as you. For buyers I'm a builder Join the qualified buyer community and get first look at parcels that fit your buy box — before they go anywhere else. Qualification takes about three minutes. Get qualified For finders I find deals Register a parcel with the house and it's locked to you for 30 days. We price every offer and handle disposition. You keep 50% of the fee we collect. Register a parcel For owners I'm selling property Own commercial or industrial property — land, a building, a teardown site? We buy directly — cash, as-is, fast and certain close. No listing, no showings, no broker fees. Tell us about your property Our standard: quality and time We function on quality and time , and that's what we give people. Sellers get a fast, certain close. Partners get paid when deals close. So every builder in this community is qualified on closing pace before a single deal goes out — a slow close ties up everybody's money, and we don't do that to our sellers or our partners. How it works 1. Deals are originated owner-direct Our partners work owners directly — no daisy chains, no recycled lists. Every parcel is verified: zoning, acreage, ownership. 2. Every parcel passes a full gate Criteria fit, numbers, recorded comps. We price at 65% of what a builder credibly pays for the dirt — never off a seller's ask. 3. Qualified builders get the drop Deals go only to builders whose box they fit, fastest closers first, on a stated clock. Clean packet: the deal, the numbers, the timeline. Questions before you start? The builder form takes about three minutes and asks only what we need to match you with the right parcels. Partner registration takes two. What we buy Development land, warehouses and industrial buildings, teardown and redevelopment sites, and industrial outdoor storage yards. Our industrial lane works sites of five acres and up; other commercial parcels are reviewed on fit. Everything is originated owner-direct and off-market — we do not work fresh listings, and we do not touch daisy chains. If a parcel cannot be verified — zoning, acreage, ownership — it does not go out to builders. If it can, it is priced off recorded comps and matched to the builders whose box it fits. What it costs Free for builders, partners, and sellers — no membership, seat, per-lead, or per-deal charges, ever. The house earns one way: a fee inside the contract assignment when a deal closes. If a deal does not close, we do not earn, and nobody owes us anything for looking. How an offer is made Once a parcel clears the gate, we take it to qualified builders whose box it fits — fastest closers first, on a stated first-look clock. Terms are agreed up front: the assignment, earnest money, and the closing date. If a builder passes, we say so and move to the next fit. When a contract is signed, title runs the assignment and the clock is watched all the way to the closing table. We work Florida first, where our builder bench is deepest, and we take on new markets builder by builder — never by spraying listings. Questions, answered straight What does Lot & Loaded do? We originate off-market commercial parcels — industrial land, redevelopment and teardown sites — and put them under contract at 65% of builder value. Qualified builders see the deals that fit their box, partners register parcels with the house, and owners can sell to us directly. What does it cost to join? Nothing. There are no membership fees for builders, partners, or sellers. We make money when deals close — our fee is inside the contract assignment — so we only earn when you do. How are parcels priced? Every parcel passes a full gate: criteria fit, numbers, and recorded comps. We price at 65% of what a builder credibly pays for the property — never off a seller's asking price. Who sees the deals? Only qualified builders whose buy box the parcel fits. Builders are qualified on closing pace before any deal goes out, and the fastest closers see fitting deals first, on a stated clock. I'm a wholesaler — how do I work with you? Register your parcel on the Partners page before first contact. It is locked to you for 30 days, HQ prices every offer, and you keep 50% of the fee actually collected, paid when the fee lands. Lot & Loaded — off-market commercial origination. Deals are presented to qualified buyers only.

What you receive A parcel packet with the facts the gate verified: acreage, zoning, access, and recorded comp support, with the price and its basis shown. No inflated values and no dressed-up projections — the numbers on the packet are the numbers the price was built on. You get a decision window that matches the pace you stated at qualification, and a straight answer when the clock runs out; deals are re-offered, not sat on. ===== Partners — Register a Parcel | Lot & Loaded (https://santi856.github.io/lot-and-loaded/partners.html) =====

LOT & LOADED Builders Partners Sell your property Partner lead registration Register a parcel. Register before first contact and the lead is locked to you for 30 days . HQ runs the full gate and prices every offer — no offer goes to a seller until the house runs it. You keep 50% of the net assignment fee actually collected , paid when the fee lands. 100% commission — no salary, no hourly, no draw. Free to join. No membership fees — we make money when deals close, same as you. You Your name * Email * Phone * Languages you work in The parcel Property address * Acreage Zoning (as listed by the county appraiser) Owner name * Owner phone (skip-traced) * A lead isn't a lead without the owner and a phone that reaches them. If you don't have them yet, get them first — then register. Asking price (if listed) Where does it stand? Select… Off-market — no contact yet Off-market — in conversation Listed — 90+ days on market Tax deed / foreclosure exposure Under contract with the house Anything HQ should know — motivation, condition, site flags Register this parcel Submitting registers the lead under your name with a 30-day lock, starting now. Unregistered leads are not protected. Hand-worked outreach only — your own phone, your own accounts. Registered. Your 30-day lock starts now. HQ runs the gate — criteria fit, numbers, comps, buyer match — and comes back with the number. No offer goes to the seller before that, from anyone. How a registration works One: register the parcel before first contact — the lock starts at submission and runs 30 days. Two: HQ runs the full gate: criteria fit, the numbers, recorded comps, and a match against qualified builders' buy boxes. Three: the house prices the offer — no offer goes to a seller from anyone until that happens. Four: the deal goes to qualified builders, fastest closers first, on a stated clock. Five: when the assignment fee is collected, your 50% is paid. Registration is free, and it is the only way a lead is protected — unregistered leads are first come, first served. What counts as a lead The property address, the owner's name — the signer, not a gatekeeper — and a skip-traced phone that reaches them. Acreage and zoning help the gate move faster. Listed deals need 90 or more days on market. Hand-worked outreach only: your own phone, your own accounts. What HQ does for free Skip-tracing the owner, running the recorded comps, pricing the offer, writing the outreach, working every reply, and matching the deal to qualified builders — the house does all of it, on every registered lead, at no cost to you. Your job is finding parcels worth registering: off-market, owner-direct, with the owner reachable. Where to find them: tax-delinquent industrial parcels, long-held family land, estates with out-of-state heirs, and owners paying carrying costs on vacant warehouses that no longer serve them. If a parcel is already under contract with another wholesaler, or the house is already working the owner, we tell you at registration — not after you have spent a week on it. Questions, answered straight How does the 30-day lock work? Register a parcel before first contact and the lead is locked to you for 30 days, starting the moment you submit. Unregistered leads are not protected. When and how do I get paid? You keep 50% of the net assignment fee actually collected on your deals, paid when the fee lands. It is 100% commission — no salary, no hourly, no draw. Can I send the seller an offer myself? No. HQ runs the full gate — criteria fit, numbers, recorded comps, buyer match — and prices every offer. No offer goes to a seller until the house runs it, from anyone. What makes a lead count? The property address, the owner's name, and a skip-traced phone that reaches the owner. A lead without the owner and a phone is not a lead yet — get them first, then register. What kinds of parcels fit? Off-market commercial and industrial property: development land, warehouses and industrial buildings, teardown and redevelopment sites, and outdoor storage yards. Listed deals need 90 or more days on market. Lot & Loaded — partner registration. Terms: 50/50 of the fee actually collected, paid when collected.

===== Sell Your Property | Lot & Loaded (https://santi856.github.io/lot-and-loaded/sell.html) =====

LOT & LOADED Builders Partners Sell your property For property owners Selling your property? We buy commercial and industrial property directly — land, warehouses and industrial buildings, teardown and redevelopment sites, outdoor storage yards — cash, as-is, fast and certain close . No listing, no showings, no broker fees, nothing out of your pocket. Tell us about the property and, if it fits the builders we work with, we come back with a real number fast — priced off what builders actually pay for property like yours, not a guess. If it doesn't fit, we'll tell you that too. Free — sellers never pay us anything. You Your name * Email * Phone * Is that number on WhatsApp? Yes No Not sure Your connection to the property I own it I'm an owner in the entity that owns it I represent the owner The property Property address * Acreage Zoning (if you know it) What is the property? Sending this is not a contract and doesn't obligate you to anything — it just starts the conversation. Got it. Your property is with us. We run every property through the same gate — zoning, acreage, recorded sales of similar property — and if it fits our builders, you hear back with a real number fast. If it doesn't fit, we'll tell you that instead of going quiet. What we buy Vacant and development land, warehouses and industrial buildings, teardown and redevelopment sites, and outdoor storage yards. Our industrial lane works sites of five acres and up; smaller commercial parcels are reviewed on fit. Condition is not a deal-breaker by itself — we buy as-is, and the form has room to tell us about tenants, taxes, or anything else on the property. How it works Send the form and your property goes through the same gate as every deal: zoning, acreage, and recorded sales of similar property. If it fits the builders we work with, we come back with a real number fast — cash, as-is, on a fast and certain close. If it doesn't fit, we tell you that straight instead of going quiet. Prefer to talk first? Text or call (838) 304-3003. What we look at Recorded sales of similar property near yours, the zoning and what can actually be built, acreage and road access, utilities, and what the builders we work with are buying right now. We do not price off tax assessments or online estimates. If your property has environmental questions or title issues, tell us in the notes — surprises found later slow everything down; facts up front usually don't. Inherited property, property behind on taxes, and property held by partners who no longer agree on it are all situations we see; tell us the situation and we will work with it. If we agree a number, the contract is plain: cash, as-is, and a closing date inside a fast window that you agree to. No open houses and no strangers walking your property. Questions, answered straight What kinds of property do you buy? Commercial and industrial property: vacant and development land, warehouses and industrial buildings, teardown and redevelopment sites, and outdoor storage yards. What will you pay for my property? We price off recorded sales of similar property and what builders actually pay for property like yours — not a guess. If your property fits the builders we work with, you hear back with a real number fast. Do I pay any fees? No. Sellers never pay us anything — no listing fees, no showings, no broker fees, nothing out of your pocket. What happens after I send the form? We run your property through the same gate as every deal: zoning, acreage, and recorded sales of similar property. If it fits, we come back with a real number. If it doesn't fit, we tell you that instead of going quiet. Does sending the form obligate me to sell? No. Sending the form is not a contract and doesn't obligate you to anything — it just starts the conversation. Lot & Loaded — we buy commercial and industrial property directly. Cash, as-is, fast close.
